subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should this PR establish the grouped Claw v1 manifest and plan contract now, including whether installed Claws need an immutable identity separate from the mutable agent id?
rationale: The RFC remains open, multiple downstream PRs depend on this contract, and changing identity or ownership semantics later could invalidate plan digests, provenance, update, status, and removal behavior.

options.title: Approve the complete v1 contract first
options.body: Resolve immutable install identity and other RFC ownership semantics, update this base slice if needed, then merge after exact-head proof.

options.title: Accept the current experimental contract
options.body: Explicitly accept agent id as the initial identity boundary and own possible experimental schema and JSON churn in downstream slices.

options.title: Pause the Claw stack
options.body: Keep the PRs open or close the stack until the RFC has a maintainer-sponsored product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the complete v1 contract first
recommendation.body: Resolve immutable install identity and other RFC ownership semantics, update this base slice if needed, then merge after exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the broadest concrete review of the base schema, planner, canonical OpenClaw boundaries, and downstream readiness contract.
